description: Defines inline functions and prototypes for USB device state management and control transfer handling in Zephyr OS, specifically for USB device class 9 (USB device framework).

methods.name: usbd_state_is_default
methods.description: Checks if the USB device is in the default state.

methods.name: usbd_state_is_address
methods.description: Checks if the USB device is in the address state.

methods.name: usbd_state_is_configured
methods.description: Checks if the USB device is in the configured state.

methods.name: usbd_get_config_value
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration value of the USB device.

methods.name: usbd_set_config_value
methods.description: Sets the current configuration value of the USB device.

methods.name: usbd_get_alt_value
methods.description: Gets the alternate setting for a specified interface.

methods.name: usbd_set_alt_value
methods.description: Sets the alternate setting for a specified interface.

methods.name: usbd_get_setup_pkt
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the last received setup packet.

methods.name: usbd_init_control_pipe
methods.description: Initializes the control pipe to default values.
